'''PT-3''' was a [[droid]] who lived with the [[Chadra-Fan]] [[Marlaa Jinara]] after being abandoned by [[PT-3's owner|his previous owner]].<ref name="Junkyard Sleepover" />

==Biography==
Sometime around [[232 BBY]], PT-3 was abandoned on the planet [[Tenoo]] by his former owner. Needing repairs, PT-3 scavenged around Marlaa Jinara's [[Marlaa Jinara's junkyard|junkyard]] for new parts. Upon doing this, PT-3 inadvertently scared Marlaa and [[JG-1]], who thought he was a [[Gloomling]].<ref name="Junkyard Sleepover" />

Shortly after, a group of [[Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate|younglings]] - [[Kai Brightstar]], [[Lys Solay]], and [[Nubs]] - helped Marlaa catch the "Gloomling". Upon discovering that PT-3 was a droid and not a Gloomling, Marlaa repaired him, and allowed him to stay in the junkyard with her and JG-1 from that point on.<ref name="Junkyard Sleepover" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
PT-3 first appeared in the episode "[[Junkyard Sleepover]]" from the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''.<ref name="Junkyard Sleepover" /> This droid was modeled by Gabriel Lopez.<ref>{{ArtStation|url=artwork/9EQqev|username=gabelopez|name=[[Gabriel Lopez]]|text=Star Wars Young Jedi Adventures – Droids 1}}</ref>
